text:
anya: Quick sync — ACME POC requirements: EU-only data path, BYOK for customer keys, and a current sub-processor list. Legal flagged SSO/DPA questions. Need ops + pricing input on geo-routing options and cost delta. Who can take this?

sam: I can pick up ops. Do we have an option to pin inference to eu-west-1 for hosted?

marcus: We can geo-pin at the routing layer but hosted control-plane signaling still exits via control-plane region unless we run Private. Short version: hosted + geo-pin = data in EU for payloads but control plane metadata may cross borders.

anya: Customer explicitly asked for control-plane inside EU. They're leaning Private or Dedicated. Can we get a cost comparison (monthly reserved vs hosted with egress/cross-border premium)?

jared: @sam @marcus I can help with numbers — need expected TPS and token/sec envelope. Any estimates?

anya: For POC: 5 qps steady, spikes to ~20 qps. Mostly short prompts. Token mix ~120 tokens/req.

maria: FYI sub-processors: we have updated vendor list in Confluence but customer wants an exported notarized list + SOC2 dates. Legal will need that packaged.

sally-legal: @anya @maria I can pull the subproc export. Also need confirmation of KMS flow: BYOK means keys never leave customer KMS; we support envelope encryption, but Private deployment is easiest for attestation. Please confirm which model of BYOK: HSM-backed external or hosted KMS?

anya: They want HSM-backed external KMS (BYOK-HSM).

sam: Ops note: BYOK-HSM + hosted means we must route TLS tunnel to customer HSM endpoints and ensure mutual TLS + IP allowlist. That adds networking + support effort. Also impacts failover — fallback will have to be to a non-BYO mode unless we replicate keys.

marcus: On routing policy: we can present two flavors: 1) Private control plane (full EU), 2) Hosted geo-pin (data flows EU, control plane may be US) + contractual DPA. Both viable but different risk profiles and cost.

jared: Cost ballpark for Dedicated (reserved for that capacity): ~$8k/mo for the POC profile. Hosted with geo-pin + egress guarantees: ~$2.2k/mo + one-time networking setup ~$4k. + BYOK-HSM integration SOW ~$6k. Will validate.

anya: Great — can you turn that into a one-pager we can share with the AE, and include decision matrix (security, cost, time-to-live)?

maria: I'll deliver subproc export and SOC2 certs by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder: presales-runbook template: 
```
routing_policy: "geo_pin: eu-west-1"
control_plane: "private: false"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: external"
fallback: "model_variant: smaller-eu-quant"
```
Add network requirements: mTLS, IP allowlist, NAT rules.

sally-legal: Also adding: we need customer's signed DPA + statement on control plane acceptable regions if they accept hosted. If they reject hosted control plane outside EU -> Private required.

anya: Action items: @jared prepare pricing one-pager, @maria deliver subproc + certs, @sam/marcus ops plan + network checklist, @sally-legal assemble DPA checklist. I'll coordinate with AE and schedule a 30m handoff call tomorrow.

sam: Oncall: please add an ops contact for the POC — I'll be primary.

marcus: I'll draft the routing diagram and post to the thread with the diagram link.

anya: Thanks all :raised_hands: — will ping when the one-pager is ready and attach to the presales ticket.
